title: The Clay Yard and the Vail House — Low Kiln, Sill
caption: The close ground of Low Kiln drawn at the scale a clay child walks: the Clay Yard with its slip pits and ruts, the Vail kiln-house with its hearth, loaf shelf and bed, the wheel-shed with the Debt Loft and the finger's-width-open back room, the drying racks with the space beneath the lowest, the row of houses to House Silt, the smithy, the well and the birth-flower shrine, the Slip Brook behind and the Ilm at the reedbeds. Surveyed and inked in Y.H. 812, the Thin Year.
